summary:
Implementation plan to address all reported APK issues:
1. Fix Google Play Services / GoogleAuthHelper compilation error.
2. Implement Firebase Phone Auth SMS OTP verification flow with on-screen fallback and resend timer.
3. Integrate Android Photo Picker (Gallery) and Camera capture for property listings.
4. Cap loan amounts to ₹1 Crore max with updated EMI calculations.
5. Remove pre-saved hardcoded locations and add GPS auto-detection with Android Location permissions.
